introHtml: Yellow address books stand out in a stack of standard black or navy options, making them a smart choice for branding that gets noticed. Whether you are handing them out at a trade show or including them in new-hire welcome kits, the bright cover color signals approachability and optimism. These custom books pair well with foil stamping or full-color imprint on the front, giving your logo a clean, professional look that recipients will reach for daily.
